title: 第333章 险地第334章 村庄
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: 亡灵骑士团化作探险小队，在熔火秘境开始探索起来。
“这里怎么越走越荒芜？”杰克环绕四周，疑惑道。
他们原先降落的地方还是一片草地，可走着走着，四周的草全都变成了石头，周边也只有零零散散几棵，已经没了树叶的枯树，显得格外萧瑟。
更让人不安的是，空气中的能量开始剧烈躁动，仿佛有什么东西正在暗处窥探，压抑感越来越浓。
“嘎嘎嘎。”
几声刺耳的乌鸦叫声突然响起，打破了秘境的寂静。
梅比斯浑身一僵，猛地抬起头。
“怎么了梅比斯？”林奇察觉到她的异样，低声问道。
梅比斯紧紧抓着林奇的手，小脸上满是警惕：“这群乌鸦在召唤它的同类。”
“召唤同类？”
三人一同惊呼，连忙抬眼望向天空。
只见远处的天际，越来越多的乌鸦正朝着他们的方向飞来，黑压压的一片，遮天蔽日。
这些乌鸦的模样十分怪异，羽毛漆黑，喙部泛着诡异的灰光，连眼睛都是浑浊的暗红色。
哪怕是林奇也从未见过这种种类的乌鸦。
他转头看向安琪拉，后者也是皱着眉摇了摇头，显然也不清楚。
“杰克，你去弄一只过来，尸体就行，我要看看这东西的底细。”
杰克当即隐身，向着一棵枯树下走去。
一道短促的叫声响起，一只乌鸦便从树上坠落下来。
杰克解除隐身，快步捡起乌鸦的尸体，折返回到林奇身边。
“封印。”
林奇将这只乌鸦封印起来，融合卡瞬间得知了卡牌信息。
鬼鸦
星级：三星
品质：绿色
属性：普通
卡阶：于特殊地阶诞生的卡兽，以腐肉尸体为食
由于只是一具尸体，林奇无法得知它的具体技能和特殊能力。
但仅仅一只鬼鸦就有三星实力，此刻天空中聚集的鬼鸦越来越多，这等数量哪怕是御卡大师也会被啃食殆尽。
“不能耽搁，大家快点往前走！”
林奇当机立断，拉着梅比斯率先迈步。
“要不要让坐骑带我们飞出去？”安琪拉问道。
“不行。”
林奇果断拒绝。
“卡兽的体型巨大，对它们来说更是绝佳美食。
尤其是这些鬼鸦擅长空中领域，在陆地上我们的进攻手段还多一点，一旦飞到空中被它们包围，那便彻底没有办法了。”
的确。
content_en:
The Undead Knights turned into an expedition team and began exploring the Molten Secret Realm.
"Why is this place getting more and more deserted?" Jack asked, wondering, as he looked around.
The place where they originally landed was still a piece of grass, but as they walked, the grass around them all turned into stones, and there were only a few scattered dead trees with no leaves around, making them look particularly desolate.
What's even more unsettling is that the energy in the air begins to violently agitate, as if something is spying in the dark, and the sense of oppression is getting stronger and stronger.
"Quack, quack, quack."
Several harsh crow calls suddenly sounded, breaking the silence of the secret realm.
Mavis froze and raised his head suddenly.
"What's wrong, Mavis?" Lynch noticed something strange about her and asked in a low voice.
Mabius held Lynch's hand tightly, his little face full of vigilance: "These crows are calling their kind."
"Summoning the same kind?"
The three of them exclaimed together and quickly raised their eyes to the sky.
In the distant sky, more and more crows were seen flying in their direction, and the sky was filled with darkness, blocking out the sun.
These crows look very strange, with dark feathers, a strange gray light in their beaks, and even their eyes are turbid dark red.
Even Lynch had never seen this kind of crow.
He turned to look at Angela, who also frowned and shook her head, obviously not clear either.
"Jack, go get one, just a corpse. I want to see the details of this thing."
"Okay."
Jack immediately became invisible and walked towards a dead tree.
"Gah!"
A short cry sounded, and a crow fell from the tree.
Jack released his invisibility, quickly picked up the crow's body, and returned to Lynch.
"Seal."
Lynch sealed the crow, and the fusion card instantly learned the card information.
Ghost Crow
Star rating: Samsung
Quality: green
Properties: normal
Ka level: Ka beasts born in special earth levels, feed on carrion corpses
Since it is just a corpse, Lynch cannot know its specific skills and special abilities.
But just one ghost crow has three-star strength. At this moment, more and more ghost crows are gathering in the sky. Even the master of card control will be eaten up by such a number.
"There can be no delay. Everyone, hurry up and move forward!"
Lynch made a prompt decision and pulled Mabis to take the lead.
"Do you want the mount to take us out?" Angela asked.
"No."
Lynch decisively refused.
“The card beasts are huge in size and are an excellent delicacy for them.
In particular, these ghost crows are good at the air domain. We have more offensive methods on land. Once we fly into the air and are surrounded by them, there is absolutely nothing we can do. "
Indeed.
